name: kit-item
about: LumaKit item (lumakit.md 2.4, lumakit-modules.md row 2). kit-item on EggStarGalaxy. placed: the stage layer of the mod places "key" (kit/item/key.json, Carry 1) 300 units in front of the start; the harness walks into it: carried is 1. spawned: an item defined in code is spawned on the player for each kind of gives in turn (Coins 3, StarBits 5, Lives 1, Health 1, Call): the game's counters move by exactly that and the Call ran once with the player. bubble: a Bubble item's object stands 250 units above its place. crystal: a Crystal item cannot be taken while its crystal stands (the player placed on it: nothing given) and is taken after the crystal is killed. inventory_reload: the stage loaded again: carried is still 1; use_one gives true then carried is 0, use_one false. mod_off: the mod taken out: its objects are gone (the count of live KitItem objects is 0). WAITING: make, model/effect/sound types, as?, *_named for the caller, kit_read binding (K); the run-time alias row and the placement-argument mark (F); kit.player.form (F) for Gives.Form.
